up: Get all distinct molecules that are associated with the document whose chembl_id is 'CHEMBL1134488' (from the docs table). The association is through compound_records: each compound_record has a doc_id and a molregno. The molregno links to molecule_dictionary. For each such molecule, return its chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its compound_name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical_smiles (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include molecules that have a canonical_smiles value (i.e., that have an entry in compound_structures). Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles, all in ascending order. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1134488' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
